findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "microsoft_escalation" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: companies_new, tenders, microsoft_diagnose, microsoft_outage · Private data: property_rents, tenders_supplier, microsoft_tenant_signins, microsoft_tenant_health, microsoft_tenant_user, microsoft_tenant_setup · Public sink: epc_areas, ebay_market, companies_new, companies_overdue, tenders, shopify_store, poshmark_search, reverb_search, tenders_buyer, jobs_search · Destructive: microsoft_diagnose.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: companies_new, tenders, microsoft_diagnose, microsoft_outage · Private data: property_rents, tenders_supplier, microsoft_tenant_signins, microsoft_tenant_health, microsoft_tenant_user, microsoft_tenant_setup · Public sink: epc_areas, ebay_market, companies_new, companies_overdue, tenders, shopify_store, poshmark_search, reverb_search, tenders_buyer, jobs_search · Destructive: microsoft_diagnose

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
